photon.jaws: X1 and X2 are the lower jaws and Y1 and Y2 the upper jaws; each setting is the distance from the collimator axis to the jaw edge, projected to the isocenter
photon.mlc: Millennium 120-leaf tertiary MLC, mounted below the X and Y jaws
photon.blocks: cerrobend blocks on a 0.6 cm acrylic block tray in the accessory mount
photon.wedges: external physical wedges of 15, 30, 45 and 60 degrees in the accessory mount

tables.pddn_6mv_ssd100.csv: normalized percent depth dose PDDN (d0 = 10 cm), SSD 100 cm, by depth and square field size
tables.tpr_6mv.csv: tissue phantom ratio TPR (d0 = 10 cm), by depth and square field size
tables.scatter_6mv.csv: total scatter factor Scp, in-air output ratio Sc and phantom scatter factor Sp (d0 = 10 cm), by equivalent square
tables.oar_6mv.csv: open field off-axis ratio, by depth and radial off-axis distance projected on a plane at 100 cm from the source
tables.wedge_factors_6mv.csv: physical wedge factor, by wedge angle, depth and side of the equivalent square

tables.electron_9mev_output_factors.csv: output factor Se at SSD 100 cm, by square insert size (side, cm) and applicator
tables.electron_ssdeff.csv: effective SSD in cm, by square insert size (side, cm) and energy
tables.electron_9mev_air_gap_factors.csv: air gap factor fair, by square insert size (side, cm, defined at SSD 100 cm) and SSD in cm
